user_priority: Original direct RGB-only YOLOX-X plus ByteTrack; minimum +5 absolute full-Test HOTA, stretch +10. No additional RGB architecture search.
actual_IR: Fixed November DiffV2IR uint8 PNG, unchanged original main plan root and canonical ProtocolV2 split

fit.features: Reuse existing frozen shared-source RGB/actual-IR P3, stride8, at480x864. Canonical Train GT ROI Align3x3 mean, each branch unit length, concatenate/sqrt2.
fit.labels: Canonical video-local Train identity labels; never Dev/Test identity fitting
fit.method: Regularized Fisher projection, equal video and identity weights. Between-identity scatter centered within each Train video to avoid explicitly rewarding video separation.
fit.diagnostic: First70percent of each Train identity's temporal observations fit a diagnostic transform; late30percent retrieval reported separately. Final transform fits all1152 sampled Train frames. This is sampled feature calibration, not full27251-frame NN training.

association.feature_policy: Causal per-track normalized EMA; update only reliable nonoverlapping current observations; bounded foreground descriptor history.
association.appearance_distance: Half cosine distance of Train-fitted paired descriptor; compare with original geometric cost only inside fixed motion gate
association.selection: Frozen zero plus four Fisher weight/buffer combinations on complete two-video Dev; maximize HOTA, AssA, IDF1, then smaller buffer and weight. A positive Dev gain over identical zero authorizes one preselected full Test; preserve every failure. No per-video policy and no Test tuning.

engineering: Exact zero-path detections and MOT; frozen source and fusion bytes; actual cache anchor parity on both permitted GPUs; causal reset and no-future contract before full Dev.
storage: Reuse the existing23.45GiB Train maps read-only; no image/FPN copies. New small projection stays local. Dev candidate descriptors may be stored once as bounded compact proposals, never full-frame maps, to avoid repeated NN extraction. No weights/arrays/MOT/image upload.
